name: Org Agenda
author: Ovi Stoica
description: Today's Org agenda from your running Emacs, in the bar. Click an entry to open it in Emacs at its line. Needs Emacs running as a server.

barWidget.description: Next agenda entry, overdue count, and today's agenda in a popout. Needs Emacs running as a server.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: Next item shows the next entry's time and title. Count and Icon keep task titles off the bar, e.g. while screen sharing.

schema.label: Popout layout
schema.description: Org is your week agenda as Emacs shows it. Tabs splits it into Today, Week and Overdue. Columns puts Today beside Overdue and the week, in a wider popout. Press v in the popout to switch.

schema.label: Max title length in the bar
Let Emacs push changes (installs save/TODO hooks)
Emacs TCP server file (blank = use the socket)
Agenda files/dirs, colon-separated
schema.description: Blank uses omarchy-org-agenda-files if set in Emacs, else org-agenda-files.
